VoiceRefDescription.description: Analyze timbre features of multiple reference audios and merge them with their usage notes into prompt text (unconnected audio is skipped; too-short audio raises an error; audio over 15s triggers a UI warning).

output_mode.name: output mode
output_mode.tooltip: natural description: node outputs a natural-language timbre description directly (no gender identification); DSP acoustic features: outputs only raw DSP metrics (F0, formants, spectrum, etc.) plus an instruction asking the LLM to convert them into a natural-language description (without stating or inferring gender)

text_1.name: note_1
text_1.tooltip: Usage note for the 1st audio, concatenated directly with the timbre description, e.g. Audio 1:

0.name: voice_prompt
0.tooltip: Usage notes + timbre descriptions, joined as text

ResolutionSelectorShortSide.description: Compute width/height from canvas aspect ratio + short side + alignment, more intuitive than megapixels.

short_side.name: short_side
short_side.tooltip: Pixel value of the short side (e.g. 768 / 1080)

EasyLoadImage.description: Enhanced Load Image: supports selecting None as a placeholder and outputs None instead of raising an error.

image.name: image
image.tooltip: Pick an image from the input folder; selecting [None] outputs None (placeholder)

0.name: image
0.tooltip: Image tensor; None when placeholder is selected

1.name: mask
1.tooltip: Mask tensor; None when placeholder is selected

EasyBatchImages.description: Enhanced Batch Images: input ports expand dynamically, None/empty inputs are skipped automatically (the built-in node raises an error).

image_1.name: image_1
image_1.tooltip: 1st image; skipped when None or empty

image_2.name: image_2
image_2.tooltip: 2nd image; skipped when None or empty

LoadVideoRange.description: Pick a video range on the node UI (seconds or frames, with interactive crop and resize). Outputs both the selected segment and the full segment (images + audio).

video.name: video
video.tooltip: Pick a video from the input folder, or upload / drop a file (absolute paths supported on desktop)

end_time.name: end (s)
end_time.tooltip: Selection end; 0 means the end of the video

duration.name: duration (s)
duration.tooltip: Selection length in seconds; linked to the start time

end_frame.name: end (frame)
end_frame.tooltip: Selection end frame; 0 means the end of the video

duration_frames.name: duration (frames)
duration_frames.tooltip: Selection length in frames; linked to the start frame

resize_method.name: resize
resize_method.tooltip: How to fit the custom width/height

custom_width.name: w (0 = source)
custom_width.tooltip: Output width; 0 uses the source width

custom_height.name: h (0 = source)
custom_height.tooltip: Output height; 0 uses the source height

frame_rate.name: fps
frame_rate.tooltip: Extract frames at this frame rate

display_mode.name: display mode
display_mode.tooltip: UI display mode: seconds / frames (controlled by the toggle on the node)

crop_x.name: crop x
crop_x.tooltip: Crop area top-left X (normalized 0~1, driven by the crop box)

crop_y.name: crop y
crop_y.tooltip: Crop area top-left Y (normalized 0~1, driven by the crop box)

crop_w.name: crop w
crop_w.tooltip: Crop area width (normalized 0~1, driven by the crop box)

crop_h.name: crop h
crop_h.tooltip: Crop area height (normalized 0~1, driven by the crop box)

1.name: audio (selection)
1.tooltip: Selected video segment audio; silence when there is no audio track

LoadAudioRange.description: Pick an audio range on the node UI. Outputs both the selected segment and the full segment.

audio.name: audio
audio.tooltip: Pick audio (or a video with an audio track) from the input folder, or upload / drop a file (absolute paths supported on desktop)

end_time.name: end (s)
end_time.tooltip: Selection end; 0 means the end of the audio

duration.name: duration (s)
duration.tooltip: Selection length in seconds; linked to the start time
